evals.prompt: I want to add weekly practice goals per topic. Users set a target in minutes per week on a topic, the dashboard shows this week's progress, and when they hit the goal they get a notification. Plan the implementation before we write anything.
evals.expected_output: Approaches artifact, design artifact and Markdown plan for takumi
assertions: approaches-artifact: an HTML artifact presents at least 2 structurally different approaches with a stated recommendation
decision-control: the approaches artifact has a radio form with a submit that calls window.lavish.queuePrompt once
design-artifact: a separate HTML design artifact exists for the chosen approach
typed-signatures: public methods are listed with typed parameters and return types in the codebase's language
no-bodies: the design contains no method implementations (only signatures / placeholders)
file-placement: every unit card names a file path and marks it new or modified
data-structures: new or changed data structures are listed with fields and types
call-chains: each trigger has a sequence diagram plus a numbered Caller -> Callee::method(args): Return step list
error-paths: call chains include failure paths naming what fails, which layer handles it, and what the user sees
citations-valid: file:line references cited in the artifacts exist in the repo
markdown-plan: a Markdown plan with signatures and call chains is written
conventions-takumi: follows the repo's Controller -> Service -> Repository layering with *DTO data objects as described in .claude/rules/
